prompt_en: A photographic magical-travel scene with a fictional traveler, an unmistakably adult woman sharing a moment between journeys. Preserve the supplied photograph's facial structure and hair: chin-length dark-brown bob, wispy separated fringe, large brown eyes, a softly tapered jaw, and naturally full lips. She pauses on a highland footbridge above a dark lake, boots planted on rain-dark stone paving, looking toward the camera with quiet, attentive eyes and slightly parted lips. Her white collared shirt is the innermost travel layer, enclosed by a gray knitted V-neck sweater. A red-and-gold diagonally striped tie descends flat against that white shirt and continues below the sweater's V-shaped opening. An open-front black robe with wide hanging sleeves wraps around the sweater and both inner layers, all worn by the same traveler. Her right hand wraps around a wooden broom shaft diagonally beside her body, ending in a clearly separate bound bundle of dry twigs near the paving. Her left hand rests palm-up beside a snowy owl perched on the stone parapet; a small pale envelope lies beneath the owl's gripping talons. The owl has a rounded white head, yellow eyes, and white plumage with scattered black flecks. Across the lake, a large weathered stone castle rises from a steep rocky ridge, its unequal round towers capped with pointed conical roofs, taller spires, and clustered steep gables. The pale envelope and the eyes form a small bright triangle, while the broom shaft echoes the receding bridge line. A cool clearing-rain sky illuminates her face, damp cloth folds and the owl's feathers; warm pinpoints in distant castle windows mark the destination behind her. Keep her face, collar, broom grip, owl feet and letter, and the distant tower silhouettes readable within one horizontal environmental portrait. Use natural photographic texture, gentle side light, and sufficient depth for distinct castle shapes while the traveler remains the visual center.
